parent.r62_result: Original full G4/G5/G7 PASS; source/initial hash match for both OS and seeds, all 17408/17408 original categorical actions identical on SPENT R60 source. Raw weight bytes diverge at AdamW step2, gradients at step3; scientific improvement not established.

hypothesis: Canonical seed-derived MLP initialization will retain exact final categorical cross-platform parity and competent learned action prediction across prospectively FRESH independent four-law world samples, without reusing R60 spent target settings or tuning thresholds. The same conventional GRU, public quadratic interpolator and negative controls must qualify. Passing admits a synthetic benchmark, not a Native mechanism.

source.public_decision_objective: At unobserved public target t, choose source action0 iff f(t)>=0; labels from independent actual action0/action1 selected reset trials FIT only, never supplied to model features.
source.source_custody: Use same R59/R60 4-law mechanism and actually selected terminal+proxy causal observations with NEW frozen source salts, independent coefficients and source noises. Synthesize each split once and do not load previously scored FIT/CAL/OOD source; source salting differs from R59/R60.

models.MLP: Exact r60.Policy MLP 10->64 ReLU->64 ReLU->2 float64; initialize BOTH OS with unmodified r62.canonical_init including precommitted seed hashes.
models.GRU: Exact r60.Policy GRU 3×4 features->hidden32->2 logits float64; original normal torch initial seed. Require exact categorical parity nonetheless, no assertion that GRU weight bytes match.
models.optimizer: AdamW lr=.003 weight_decay=0, clip_grad_norm=1, batch128. Source/model FP64, one CPU thread, deterministic_algorithms=True, mkldnn=False.
public_fixed_controls: 3-point observed actual terminal quadratic Lagrange interpolation
models.evaluation_arrays: For each of four model instances: FIT_train4096, heldout768, CAL768, OOD active1024, OOD erase terminal1024, OOD erase proxy1024; plus each of four fixed controls on all four splits

frozen_acceptance.if_fail: NO-GO, preserve all original data/score and freeze. Never retune this scored cohort, decision tie, model, seeds, source salts or thresholds.
frozen_acceptance.if_pass: Fresh synthetic four-law selected-intervention task admitted with exact action portability and competent conventional controls; new mechanism's science still requires another separately frozen, matched-information/action/compute source and stronger fixed-baseline comparison.
